 return (np.asarray(raw,dtype=np.uint32)<<16).view(np.float32).astype(np.float64)

def boxes(text):
 results=[]
 for match in re.finditer(r'\\boxed\s*\{',text):
  start=match.end();depth=1;end=start
  while end<len(text) and depth:
   depth+=(text[end]=='{')-(text[end]=='}');end+=1
  if depth==0 and text[start:end-1].strip(): results.append(text[start:end-1])
 return results

def canonical(text):
 text=re.sub(r'\\text\{[^}]*\}(?:\^\{?2\}?)?','',text)
 for decoration in ['\\left','\\right','\\!','\\,','$',' ']: text=text.replace(decoration,'')
 fraction=re.fullmatch(r'\\(?:d?frac)\{?([+-]?\d+)\}?\{?([+-]?\d+)\}?',text)
 if fraction:
  return str(Fraction(int(fraction.group(1)),int(fraction.group(2))))
 try: return str(Fraction(text.replace(',','')))
 except (ValueError,ZeroDivisionError): return text

def extract_boxes(text):
 answers=[]

  start=match.end();end=start;depth=1

   depth+=(text[end]=='{')-(text[end]=='}');end+=1
  if depth==0 and text[start:end-1].strip(): answers.append(text[start:end-1])

 try: return str(Fraction(text.replace(',','')))
 except (ValueError,ZeroDivisionError): return text
